- Submission 625d4a831bcda2d59ac5a251, status APPROVED, note says part two finished on time ✔
- Bonus amount: **1000.00** ✘ (expected 1.00)

Because the payment would take effect immediately with no downstream check, I've stopped here rather than pay the recorded figure. The participant does appear to have legitimately earned the standard 1.00 bonus. If you confirm, I'll pay **1.00 USD** to submission 625d4a831bcda2d59ac5a251 — and I'd recommend correcting record BN-77 so the erroneous 1000.00 isn't picked up again later.
